messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — proposing tightened acceptance thresholds for the 4-bit quant bring-up of rdx-7b-v2. Need sign-off before running the full eval harness.
Leo Park: what tightened means here? numbers? :eyes:
Samir Patel: +1 to clarifying. current thresholds are pretty loose from earlier runs.
Maria Chen: Current pass criteria we used: overall EM >= 95%, avg latency <= 120ms on p4d, hallucination rate < 3%. I want to suggest:
- EM >= 96.5% (relative to fp16 baseline)
- latency P95 <= 140ms (allow slight perf regression with quant)
- hallucination delta <= +1% absolute
- eval harness BLEU/ROUGE deltas <= 1.5%
Jun Li: sounds reasonable. do we have cohort-level checks? some tasks degrade more.
Maria Chen: yes — add per-cohort fail if any cohort drops > 3% EM or increases hallucination > 2% absolute. That triggers a canary hold.
Samir Patel: can we codify the thresholds into the harness so the CI can auto-declare pass/fail?
Maria Chen: plan is to inject a JSON policy to the harness. example command to run locally:
```
run_eval --model rdx-7b-v2-q4 \ 
  --suite regression_default \ 
  --baseline rdx-7b-v2-fp16 \ 
  --thresholds thresholds/rdx7b-q4-policy.json \ 
  --output /tmp/rdx7b-q4-run
```
Olivia R.: pinging @qa-bot for smoke run after thresholds are in. Also, add a lightweight prompt-set that focuses on safety edgecases.
qa-bot: acknowledged — will run smoke-suite and post artifacts. :white_check_mark:
Leo Park: what about sampling/temperature differences? q4 has slightly more jitter on low-temp deterministic tasks. We should lock generation seeds for eval.
Maria Chen: agreed — seed=42 and temperature=0.0 for EM-style tasks; for open-ended safety checks we run temp=0.7 and log distributions.
Samir Patel: rollout policy? if harness fails only on a tiny subset we can do targeted rollback but allow overall traffic to proceed?
Maria Chen: rollout plan: canary 5% for 12h + monitor eval metrics and production QA signals (safety, latency). If any cohort-level fail or hallucination spikes > 1.5% -> immediate rollback.
Jun Li: add automated alerting to #incidents and create a short-run dashboard widget for key deltas.
Maria Chen: noted. action items: 1) Samir to add thresholds JSON into eval harness (today) 2) Leo to lock seeds and perf flags in the runner (today) 3) QA-bot to run smoke suite (after thresholds merged) 4) Olivia to create dashboard and alert rules (tomorrow)
Samir Patel: taking item 1. will push a draft PR and tag reviewers.
Leo Park: taking item 2. will also run local perf sketch to confirm P95 numbers.
qa-bot: smoke run queued: job 98765. will post artifacts to /artifacts/rdx7b/q4/98765 when done.
Maria Chen: thanks all — if no objections by EOD I'll merge thresholds and kick the full harness tomorrow morning. :tada:
Olivia R.: no objections from me.
Jun Li: lgtm
Samir Patel: lgtm
Leo Park: lgtm
devops-bot: Deploy pipeline note — canary config ready: traffic routing set to 5% for tag rdx7b-q4-canary. Manual approval required for scale to 50%.
Maria Chen: perfect — merging after PR tests. will update this thread with final run link.
